title: Approved Alternate Suppliers
summary: Supplier B (SUP-02) and Supplier C (SUP-03) are pre-approved alternates for raw-material shortfalls; Supplier A (SUP-01) has no approved alternate on file.

title: Procurement Expedite SOP
summary: Expediting from an approved alternate supplier requires Production Planning sign-off when inventory-days-on-hand at the affected plant is below 5 days.

title: Business Continuity Procedure
summary: Strategic-tier customer impact must be flagged to account management within one business day of a confirmed production-order risk.
